title: Asymptotic boundary structure of Lagrangian gauge theories
summary: Given a local gauge theory on spacetime with boundary, it naturally defines another gauge theory which can be regarded as a theory of the boundary values. For Lagrangian theories, it comes equipped with the presymplectic structure which can be used to define one or another version of Hamiltonian-like formulation of the initial model. This relation is especially manifest for AKSZ sigma models and more-generally gauge PDEs with compatible presymplectic structure in which case the boundary system is again a gauge PDE with presymplectic structure.
